name: Shepherd's Lodge, Beech Farm Cottages
why: Complex with its own indoor pool and a toddler-friendly playroom, plus a pub 50 m away; the strongest February 'facilities' option on the Yorkshire side.

name: Home Farm Holiday Cottages – Barnett's + Narroogal (or Barnett's + Plover)
place: Home Farm, Holt Road, Weybourne, Norfolk NR25 7ST
why: Closest thing to the brief by the sea: small complex with indoor pool, soft play and play area, beach and pub on foot. Live-priced today and cheaper than estimated.

name: Neddy House
why: Only Yorkshire house found with 4 proper double rooms (3 super-king en-suites + king); pub a few strides away

name: Nightingales
why: Only house found with a (near-)private indoor heated pool, 5 doubles and a walk to beach and pub; £1,258 for Mon 22 Feb 7n.

name: Tara Spa
why: Private heated indoor pool plus hot tub, gym and games room in one house, 5 double-capable bedrooms, and the shortest drive in the west for all three households.

name: Center Parcs Woburn Forest – 4-bed Woodland Lodge
why: Cheapest 4-bed Center Parcs lodge on the target dates (Mon 22 Feb 4n £559) in the newest village; the benchmark for everything else.

name: Center Parcs Sherwood Forest – 4-bed Woodland Lodge
place: Sherwood Forest, Rufford, Newark, Nottinghamshire NG21 9DN
why: The fairest-drive Center Parcs (35 min from Nottingham); same 2 double + 2 twin lodge as Woburn but £190 dearer for 4 nights.

name: Stagwood House (Stagwood Hill Farm)
why: Cheapest sleeps-11 house on the list, with a games room and big garden

name: Yard End, Killerby Old Hall
why: Sleeps 12 with 6 bedrooms, private hot tub and a shared indoor pool and bistro, between Scarborough and Filey.

name: Bayside, The Bay Filey
why: Cheapest seaside resort-style option: resort indoor pool, pub and playground 2 minutes away, beach 10 minutes' walk.

name: The Rustic Barn, Thwing
why: Best facilities lead near Bridlington: shared heated indoor pool, gym, games room and tennis court; all bedrooms en-suite.

name: The Pavilion, Sandsend
why: Best location house on the Whitby side: beach 100 m, pub and cafés walkable, every bedroom with a sea view.

name: Moor Grange Farm – The Manor House
place: Taddington Barns, Moor Lane, Flagg, nr Buxton, Derbyshire SK17 9RA
why: One big 6-bed, 4-bath house with a pool shared by only three small cottages, at a potentially low price; but only 2 fixed doubles and no online price.

name: Haddon Grove Farm Cottages – The Farmhouse
place: Haddon Grove, Monyash Road, nr Over Haddon, Bakewell, Derbyshire DE45 1JF
why: One house with 3 doubles, 3 bathrooms and a site pool, 10 min from Bakewell; published but pricey rates.

name: Swyn Llyr
why: The only west-coast shortlisted house found free for Mon 22 Feb 2027 (4 nights). It is a 5-minute walk from a beach and village, and has 4 doubles with en-suites plus a cinema and games rooms.

name: Gwelfor Barn
why: Private indoor pool with views of Puffin Island, and a separate annexe wing. It now appears to have been withdrawn from Sykes.

name: Croft House (Croft Farm & Celtic Cottages)
why: The best on-site facilities of any complex found: a heated indoor pool, soft play, an indoor play barn and daily animal feeding. Croft House itself has 6 bedrooms and a private hot tub.

name: The Farmhouse, Clydey Cottages
why: A baby-specialist complex with an indoor pool that can be booked for sole use, soft play and animal feeding, plus a 4-bed farmhouse with a private hot tub.

name: Berwyn Bank (Halls Bank Cottages)
why: Every bedroom has en-suite access, and there's a shared indoor pool only 1m deep throughout that can be hired privately (£30/hour). It's the best toddler pool found, and a short drive for Durham.

name: Warenford Cottages – The Mill House
why: Cheapest 4-bed with a shared indoor pool on the Northumberland coast; all rooms en-suite; Bamburgh/Seahouses about 15 min.

name: North Farm Cottages – Granary Stone House
why: Big house with a shared indoor pool and beach 1 mile, but it has only 3 doubles (not 4 as research had) and is pricey for a 4-night stay.

name: Village Farm – The Farmhouse
why: Winter-practical: 4 en-suite bedrooms, a heated pool bookable by the hour per cottage, and a games room and play area on site; 10 min from Alnwick.

name: The Retreat, Uploders
why: Cheapest private-pool option in the south: a Grade II thatched barn with its own indoor pool and games room; Bridport 2 mi, West Bay 3 mi.

name: Libbear Barton – Badger's House
why: Toddler complex with a private 2-hour pool session per cottage per day, soft play, a petting farm and a games room, all 9am–8pm year-round. Badger's House is the best 4-bed barn.

name: The Gables
why: Best town layout: 5 doubles incl. ground-floor en-suite, 3 baths + WC, a playroom and hot tub; walk to North Beach. Price not obtained.

name: Courtenay House
place: Harpham, nr Nafferton (Wolds edge, ~15 min from Bridlington)
why: 4 doubles and 4 bathrooms for about £1,050-1,350/wk, the cheapest proper-doubles house found.

name: Harpham Manor House
why: Grade II manor with games room and big rooms; 4n midweek £1,345; Feb half-term weeks unavailable.

name: Foremans House
why: 3 doubles + 2 twins, 4 bathrooms, rated 5.0 (26); Friday-start weeks under £1,000 in Feb.

name: Grange Farm Cottages: Bay View House (+ Low Barn optional)
place: Sewerby, 2 mi N of Bridlington centre
why: Walkable to Sewerby Hall, the clifftop and a pub; Bay View House alone has 3 doubles + twin and 3 bathrooms, with a hot tub and sea views. Price by quote only.

name: The Old School House
place: Langtoft, Yorkshire Wolds (~25 min from Bridlington)
why: 4+ doubles, 4 baths, gym and pool table, but individual spiral stairs to upper rooms and a 25-minute drive to the sea.

name: The Emberton
why: 4 doubles (2 en-suite) with sea views in north Brid; only 2 bathrooms; not priced (blocked).

name: Beach House
why: Rated 5.0 from 85 reviews, 3 bathrooms, but only 2 doubles (2 kings + 2 twins).

name: Bay View (Reighton/Speeton edge)
place: Clifftop between Reighton and Speeton (Sykes lists it under Filey)
why: Very child-ready (stairgates, cots) with sea views and hot tub; 3 doubles + family room + twin; 3 baths. Not priced.

name: Mill Race Cottage
why: 4 doubles, all en-suite, but 25 min from the sea and not priced.

name: Tennyson Grange
why: Oversized (sleeps 16) but 4 super-kings, a small games room and 'from £1,233'; not priced for our dates.

name: Lindengarth
why: 5-bed sleeps-10 house in the best micro-area; layout and bathrooms unverified.

name: Cardigan House
why: Cheap 5-bed sleeps-10 town house; layout unverified.

name: The Roost
why: Cheapest 3-double house found: every bedroom en-suite, big garden and meadow, walk to RSPB Bempton Cliffs. No pool or playroom.

name: Coombehayes Barn
why: Reference: private heated pool and 4 adult doubles, but about double the price of the others.

name: Elm Retreat (Fern House)
why: Reference: estate with shared pools and under-5s soft play; expensive and only 2 doubles.

name: Calm Waters Luxury Beach House
why: Premium beachfront benchmark: 5 bed / 4 bath, Sykes Gem Gold 2025; £3,310 for the Feb week, over budget.

name: Puffin Lodge
why: 3 doubles + twin, all en-suite; covered under Filey research.

name: Wold Cottage
why: Rated 5.0 from 123 reviews; king, double, zip-twin, twin; Filey scope.

name: Celtic Haven (now Haven Lydstep Beach Village)
White Cross Bay Holiday Park
why: Lake District resort with an indoor pool, checked as a Center Parcs-lite option.

name: Aberdovey Hillside Village (Eastward A2)
why: Seaside complex with soft play in a walkable village.

name: Kelling Heath Holiday Park
why: Norfolk woodland park next to Home Farm, Weybourne.

name: Norfolk Woods Resort
why: Norfolk resort with an indoor pool and toddler splash area.

name: Wood Farm Cottages
why: Norfolk cottage complex with a pool.

name: Hoe Grange Holidays
why: Derbyshire log-cabin site checked in the Peak sweep.
